requirements.statement: Atlas compute is replaceable from a declared image and boot configuration.
acceptance: new instance has recorded image identity
verified HTTPS and existing durable result pass
old instance is removed after rollback window

requirements.statement: Baseline capacity provides at least 2 vCPU and 2048 MiB memory, subject to live workload validation.
acceptance: resource envelope fits without unexplained throttling or OOM

requirements.statement: Atlas receives workload identity without embedded long-lived cloud access keys.
Operator access uses a named identity and bounded management path.
Only the TLS edge is publicly reachable; API and worker remain private.
DNS, TLS, health routing, idle timeouts, and drain budgets form one documented edge contract.
IPv4 and IPv6 behavior is explicitly selected and tested rather than inherited accidentally.
Durable Atlas state is independent of the replaceable root image.
Backups reside in an independent failure domain and are restored in a recurring empty-destination exercise.
Metadata access uses provider-required session/header protections and is not exposed through arbitrary proxying.
acceptance: no long-lived secret in user data

requirements.statement: The baseline is single-instance; any zone-tolerance claim requires every critical dependency to tolerate one zone loss.
acceptance: live or explicitly unexecuted failure exercise

requirements.statement: Liveness, readiness, route eligibility, and business correctness remain distinct.
Patch, image replacement, rollback, and decommission procedures preserve release and state identity.
Quotas and cost-relevant flows are recorded as availability and architecture inputs.
